The '''cosmic expansion''' is the physical expansion of [[spacetime]] itself in our [[Universe]].

== Significance ==

=== Nothing is truly stationary ===

[[File:Big bang balloon.jpg|thumbnail|As seen in this balloon analogy, even when the points on the balloon are obviously stationary, the distances between them grow over time as the "[[spacetime]] gird" itself expands]]
Under cosmic expansion, the physical distances between objects located apart from each other grow larger over time, even if they do not have any proper motion.

== Modelling ==

Cosmic expansion is modelled by the [[cosmological scale factor]].
